question.text: An electrical cable having a resistance of $0.2 \Omega$ delivers $10 \mathrm{kw}$ at $200 \mathrm{~V}$ D.C. to a factory. What is the efficiency of transmission?

solution.text:
$P=V I \Rightarrow I=\frac{10 \times 10^3}{200}=50 A$, Power loss $=(50)^2(0.2)=500 \mathrm{~W}$
Efficiency $=\frac{10000 \times 100}{10000+500}=95.23 \%$
